baslik: A Bad Weld From 1956 Exploded Under a Neighbourhood

sahneler.metin: A gas pipeline exploded under a California neighbourhood.
Fire destroyed dozens of homes, and eight people were killed.
The pipe section had been installed in 1956.
Company records said it was seamless.
In reality, it had a badly made weld.
When pressure rose, the weld tore open.
Escaping gas ignited in a huge fireball.
Operators then had to verify records and pressure-test old lines.

aciklama:
San Bruno exploded under a residential neighbourhood. The cause: rupture of a pipeline section with a defective seam weld installed in 1956.
